name: application-09
title: AI app dashboard
description: A Kivuline Roasters dashboard on the app shell: a sidebar with workspaces that goes into a sheet on phones, a top bar with search and a bell, a figures band, the agents that need you with Allow and Deny, recent activity and a usage ring. Allow a request and the whole page answers at once: the row folds away, the counts roll down, a line lands at the top of the activity and the ring grows. Plug your app into onApprove, onDeny and onWorkspaceChange.
